'''''Miscellanea Logica''''' is an [[academic journal]] of [[logic]] based at the [[Charles University in Prague]]. It is part of [[Acta Universitatis Carolinae]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Peliš |first=Michal |title=MISCELLANEA LOGICA X |url=https://karolinum.cz/data/cascislo/5383/PheH_1_2015.pdf}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=www.ff.cuni.cz |first=Filozofická fakulta Univerzity Karlovy {{!}} |date=2011-08-24 |title=Acta Universitatis Carolinae |url=https://www.ff.cuni.cz/home/research/acta-universitatis-carolinae-karolinum-press/ |access-date=2025-01-02 |website=Filozofická fakulta Univerzity Karlovy |language=en-US}}</ref>
